title: Rough, scratchy fabric. Unraveling some after a single trip through the laundry
text: Rough, scratchy fabric. Unraveling some after a single trip through the laundry. I love a nice, cozy throw and we have a bunch of them all over the house. This one is not great. It's also not cozy or snuggle worthy. The texture is very rough and scratchy against bare skin. Even after washing it, it's still scratchy. After washing, I'm seeing some loose threads here and there. It's just not suitable for my needs and I think this will end up being used in our emergency dog rescue kit and not in our home.

details.Care instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Do not use bleach or fabric softeners. Tumble dry low. Do not iron. Wash before first use.
